forecast_quote_scope: One provider per release, for both four-contract anchors and all of their lags. Choose by anchor availability alone.
forecast_session_calendar: Use complete official EIA sessions through 2024-04-05, then the prepared complete-curve sessions. Anchors precede the New York calendar date of each boundary.
forecast_missing_quotes: Retain missing components. Compare the same delivery month, within the first four contracts on the lag session. Do not fill from a different source or month.
forecast_training: Keep the open-period cohorts and the original model settings. Update each walk-forward model only from labels available strictly before the forecast cutoff. Choose adaptive profile families from the development period, as in the original models.
forecast_primary_metric: paired difference in mean absolute error in million barrels
execution_quote_scope: One provider for both fixed delivery months and all five sessions. First eligible settlement through fifth, using the precomputed nonoverlapping calendar for each cohort.
execution_primary_metric: paired difference in mean net USD per common eligible window at 50 USD per round trip
